survey.text:
Your privacy choices
Fideo processes the following privacy rights in accordance with applicable privacy laws for all individuals, regardless of where the individual is located. For example, if we sell your personal data for monetary or other valuable consideration or share your personal data for cross-context behavioral advertising, you have the right to opt-out of such “sale” or “sharing/targeted advertising.” If we collect or process your sensitive personal data for the purpose of inferring characteristics about you, you have the right to request that we limit the use or disclosure of such i

review.notes: Refused email requests (2026-10-15). Use the Privacy Choices portal (access, deletion, opt-out).

basis.quote: Despite higher privacy protections afforded in certain jurisdictions (e.g., California, Colorado, Connecticut, Utah, Virginia, and the European Economic Area and United Kingdom), Fideo strives to provide the same privacy rights and transparency to all Users and Consumers regardless of their location
